### Cycle 3

**Cycle 3 measurements (post-cycle-3 dev work)**:

- `grep -nE 'web\.open|webOpenTool' packages/happy-app/sources/app/(app)/dev/codex-render-fixtures-data.ts` → 5 matches (lines 241, 242, 244, 537, 538) + 3 `webOpenTool` references (lines 243, 540, 541). Image-render via Read tool on the three §5.3.B per-row PNGs confirmed each shows the correct row's IMAGE_INLINE_GENERATION / IMAGE_ATTACHMENT / IMAGE_INLINE_SCREENSHOT panel headers with rendered preview content (red placeholder image bytes + filenames `generated-image.png`, `plot.png`, `playwright-fixture.png`) — not blank rows.

No mapper, renderer, or out-of-scope file edits. Diff stats from dev report: 3 files changed, 29 lines added, 0 lines removed.
- Build: `scripts/dev-overnight-build-deploy.sh /dev/shm/dev-workspace/happy-dev frontend` succeeded (50s); `happy-web-dev` recreated; `curl http://localhost:8097/` returned HTML; `curl http://localhost:3005/health` returned `{"status":"ok"}`.

- No production access (Playwright navigated only to `http://localhost:8097`); no daemon restart; no `npm install -g`; no `/usr/bin/happy` invocation.
